<think>The project is "Japanese Paper Marbling in the Browser" (Suminagashi). The browser reading snapshot shows it's a creative/artistic product — an interactive simulation of suminagashi (Japanese paper marbling). It has controls for different inks (Sumi, Ai, Bengara, etc.), tools (Alternate, Ink, Clear, Blow, Hair), a "Dip" button, "Drift", "New water", print, etc.

This is a creative, visual project. Does it meet the criteria?
- Interesting product idea: Yes, an interactive digital simulation of a traditional art form (suminagashi) with various tools and effects. It's creative and visual.
- Creative way of presenting something: Yes.
- Useful sample of what people are building: Yes.

It's a small, creative, well-defined product. Definitely "interesting" and creative. I'll push.

Reason: It's a creative, interactive simulation of the traditional Japanese art of suminagashi with a nice set of tools, which is exactly the kind of fun, visual small product that's worth a look.
